title: Pocket RPG Kit
intro: Example games for Pocket RPG Kit, a 2D tile-RPG runtime for PocketJS. They run here on the PocketJS core compiled to WebAssembly, from the same bundles the desktop host and the tests run.

showcase.title: Pocket RPG Kit Feature Gallery
showcase.description: A walkable exhibition of the runtime: twelve focused halls demonstrate screen effects, map animation, movement, extensions, battles, shops, streamed maps, themes, saves and deterministic replay.
features: 1. Screen Effects — screenFade / screenTint / screenFlash / screenShake / camera / balloon / screenBackdrop
3. Runtime Appearance and Layers — appearance / layer / tileProperty
4. Movement Controls & Routes — moveControl / bounded wander / moveRoute / pathTo / approach
8. Streamed World — streamed chunks / animated tiles / 16x32 walker
9. Themes & Portraits — GameView theme / speaker portrait
10. Input Locks & World Idle — lockInput / unlockInput / worldIdle
11. Saves & Save Codes — SaveMenu / encodeSaveCode / decodeSaveCode
12. Attract Tour & Rewind — attract tape / takeover / rewind

controls.action: Walk through the gallery and enter a hall

wander.title: Wander: an Endless Grown World
wander.description: An unbounded world streamed in 32×32 chunks around the player: towns grow as you reach them, and chunks load ahead and unload behind within a fixed memory cap. Left alone it wanders by itself; the minimap shows the rings.

controls.action: Walk. Any key takes over from the auto-walk; 10 idle seconds hand it back.
Fast travel on or off (TRI on screen)

wander.pointer: Click or tap a tile to walk there.

sunstone.title: The Sunstone of Bramble Hollow
sunstone.description: A three-map adventure through a village, a forest and a cave. Leave it alone for 10 seconds and it plays itself; press any key to take over.

controls.action: Walk, pick an answer. During the demo, any key takes over.
Hand the game back to the demo

grow.title: Rule-Grown Settlement
grow.description: Four settlements grow to the right from one seeded rule set. Scrub back to any moment, then walk into the finished village.

controls.action: Step the timeline back or forward
Pause or resume growing (TRI on screen)
Walk into the finished village; talk

grow.pointer: Drag along the timeline strip at the bottom of the screen to scrub.

meadow.title: Mini Meadow
meadow.description: The minimal example: one 20×12 map and four events, driven by the session reducer by hand.

showcase.title: Pocket Tuxemon
showcase.description: Tuxemon's world imported automatically into Pocket RPG Kit: maps, NPCs, dialogue, shops and real battles, from Spyder's bedroom through Paper Town to Route 1. It lives on its own site; Tuxemon's art and story are GPL-3.0 / CC BY-SA.
